scripts.dev: concurrently --kill-others-on-fail -n client,server -c cyan,magenta "npm run dev -w @creative/client" "npm run dev -w @creative/server"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @creative/shared && npm run build -w @creative/client && npm run build -w @creative/server
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @creative/shared && npm run typecheck -w @creative/client && npm run typecheck -w @creative/server
